name: Turbo Flow — the rig-lite kit
postCreateCommand:
chmod +x ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/*.sh ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/setup-harness.sh 2>/dev/null || true; bash ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/rig-lite/self-test.sh; grep -q 'tf-boot' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || printf '
# tf-boot: hand the user the harness menu on their first interactive shell.
# mkdir = the atomic once-flag: claimed BEFORE the menu opens, so concurrent shells
# can never double-present, and an aborted menu never re-presents (rerun: ./setup-harness.sh)
if [[ -t 0 && -t 1 && ! -e "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" && -n "$TF_HOME" && -f "$TF_HOME/setup-harness.sh" ]] && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow" 2>/dev/null && mkdir "$HOME/.config/turbo-flow/harness-booted" 2>/dev/null; then
  ( cd "$TF_HOME" && ./setup-harness.sh )
fi
' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
